verdict.rationale: The pack shows API reference pages, available as .md, and an llms.txt index, but neither is a downloadable machine-readable API spec such as OpenAPI. A probe found that every candidate OpenAPI and Swagger path returned 404, and no vendor doc mentions an OpenAPI file. The axis applies to an API product, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
